name: @projexlight/sdk-ingest
summary: ETL batch front door (P9.2 / Epic B). Exposes POST /api/ingest/:entity/batch so external tools and ETL agents can import records into a ProjexCloud app with a documented envelope { entity, mode: upsert|insert, idempotency_key, records[] }. Lands rows idempotently in ingest.record, records provenance via sdk-lineage and an append-only entry via sdk-audit. This is the first-class import path connectors (sync-only) never provided; discoverable via the registry as kind='ingest'.

idempotency_key.description: Batch key; re-running upserts rather than duplicating.

endpoints.description: Bulk import records for an entity. Idempotent on (entity, idempotency_key, external_id). Returns per-batch import counts + per-record errors.

events.name: ingest.batch.completed.v1
events.description: An ingest batch finished; carries entity + imported/skipped counts + idempotency_key.

models.description: ETL landing table: external records keyed idempotently by (entity, idempotency_key, external_id), payload as jsonb.

hooks.name: ingestBatch
hooks.description: Service entry: validate envelope, upsert/insert records idempotently, fire lineage + audit hooks.

hooks.name: registerIngestRoutes
hooks.description: Mount POST /api/ingest/:entity/batch on the gateway fastify instance.

hooks.name: setIngestHooks
hooks.description: Wire sdk-lineage provenance + sdk-audit trail (called by the gateway at boot).

scenarios.title: ETL agent imports customer records
scenarios.when_to_use: An external system or ETL agent needs to push a batch of customer rows into a ProjexCloud app.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Records land in ingest.record idempotently; response gives imported/skipped counts; ingest.batch.completed.v1 emitted; lineage + audit recorded.

scenarios.title: Safe batch replay
scenarios.when_to_use: A network failure means the ETL job retries the same batch.
scenarios.example_code: // Re-POST the identical batch with the SAME idempotency_key.
scenarios.expected_outcome: upsert mode updates the existing rows instead of duplicating; imported reflects rows touched.

scenarios.title: Agent discovers the ingest target
scenarios.when_to_use: A coding/ETL agent asks the registry where to import an entity.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The agent gets the endpoint + payload contract and calls it without guessing.

compliance_posture.notes: Every batch is provenance-tracked (sdk-lineage source→entity) and audited (sdk-audit append-only), so imported data is traceable end-to-end. Idempotency keys prevent duplicate-on-retry.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per record imported via the batch endpoint
